name: kiff-governance
description: Scan Go agent code, place consequential actions behind KIFF governance, and adversarially audit governance guarantees.

interface.shortDescription: Scan, govern, and audit consequential agent actions
interface.longDescription: Two skills. kiff-governance uses the KIFF CLI to find consequential Go agent actions that lack a recognized governance decision, explains the findings, and helps route those actions through a real KIFF boundary. kiff-audit runs an adversarial governance audit: it extracts the guarantees a codebase claims, maps its trust boundary, constructs and executes attacks against those guarantees, runs the language's test and vulnerability tooling, and produces an evidence-backed report.
defaultPrompt: Scan this Go agent for ungoverned actions.
Help me govern these KIFF scan findings.
Add KIFF scanning to this project's CI.
Audit this repository's governance guarantees and try to break them.
